title: Tasting Cheers & Beers 🍺
description: Watch our video about how we conducted a tasting at the Extra Lounge in Serpukhov, and how it all ended

blocks.html:
Hello friends!

We would like to share with you pleasant moments from the recent presentation of our current varieties, which was held by our brand manager Alexey Kotelnikov at the Extra Lounge restaurant (Serpukhov).

The whole range of flavors was highly appreciated by the jury, and chef Dmitry Gladkov selected the perfect dishes for each of them:

BLUE MONKEY + Langoustine corn Dog with Wasabi sauce
NUT BUTTER + Burger with torn pork and onion jam
UNDERGROUND PALE + Fish & Chips with French fries and Tartar sauce
HEIDEGGER HELL + Iceberg with smoked cabbage
KETCHUP + Glazed pork ribs in "Privan" sauce
MILK OF AMNESIA V. TROPIC + Lazy cheesecake with cherries in bourbon
